parsed.title: Single Deep Reasoning Query Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock a single high-intelligence Deep Reasoning query by playing a quick partner mini-game.
parsed.trigger: When the user taps the disabled 'Deep reasoning' option (e15) on s27 while not subscribed to Luzia+.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying guest or free users who do not have the Luzia+ Subscription (r1).

offer.title: Try Deep Reasoning Free
offer.body: Play a 15-second game with Luzia to unlock 1 smarter, deeper answer.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The reward is strictly capped at 3 single-use queries per day, keeping the unlimited Deep Reasoning mode highly attractive under the main Luzia+ subscription. It also acts as a sampling mechanism to demonstrate the intelligence of premium answers.

kpis.holdout: User-level holdout, 10% of global non-paying DAU, active for 28 days

risks: Slightly increased LLM inference costs for premium reasoning models
Minor cannibalization if 1 query satisfies the user's immediate daily need

newScreens.change: An offer sheet overlay displayed when tapping Deep reasoning on s27, prompting the user to play a 15s game to unlock 1 query.

newElements.change: An interactive button displaying 'Play & Unlock' as the primary CTA next to 'No thanks'.

storyboard.caption: Guests tapping the Deep reasoning toggle are redirected to the paywall.

callouts.text: Tapping toggle now prompts a trial.

storyboard.caption: Tapping the toggle now triggers a rewarded trial offer.
Luzia offers 1 free query for playing a 15-second game.
The Simula SDK launches a 15-second interactive playable mini-game.
One Deep reasoning query is granted and the toggle activates.
